confirmedFindings.title: Recycled Transcoder State Bleeds Audio Residuals
confirmedFindings.body: Releasing transcoding contexts back into the pool without resetting internal filter states and clearing sample buffers causes the first 20-40ms of the next call to play audio fragments from the previous caller.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Zero all internal buffers and reset filter state prior to returning contexts to the pool.
